parameters.toolDescription: Ask one delivery company for a combined (lower) price on several of the customer's parcels from one checkout. The company answers later, by lowering fees or declining; fees can never go up from this. The platform words the confirmation — relay the reply. USE IT WHEN: After combined_delivery_eligible, once the customer confirmed which group (company) they want to ask. NOT THIS TOOL: Never with ids that did not come from combined_delivery_eligible. Not when that group already has an openRequestId.

parameters.toolDescription: Opens a scrollable product grid — a category, a whole shop or their saved items — with picture, price and buy button on every card. Sends its own button. USE IT WHEN: The customer wants to BROWSE a whole shelf, or asks to see everything after a page of cards. NOT THIS TOOL: Not for a specific question with a short answer — five cards via Show-Products are better. Not for one product (inapp_open_product). ⚠ Never describe the button in your own words — the customer would read it twice.

parameters.toolDescription: Draws service-listing cards (plumbers, printers, repairers and other businesses paid in person, not through Wi-Mall) for listings a search returned with kind "listing". Each card shows what the business does, where (city and area) and one button per contact detail it has. The cards carry NO contact detail: a contact is unlocked only when the customer taps its button. USE IT WHEN: product_search returned results with kind "listing", or the customer asks for a tradesperson or service provider and you have listing ids. NOT THIS TOOL: Never state, guess or repeat a business's phone, WhatsApp, email, website, address or video: you do not have them, and only the customer's tap can unlock them. Not for products (kind "product"). The cards are sent for you, so your whole answer is [sent]. ⚠ One message per card with a list of contact buttons, sent for you. Your whole answer is [sent].

parameters.toolDescription: Draws ONE service-listing card with its full description and one button per contact detail the business has. Carries no contact detail. USE IT WHEN: The customer asks about one listing already shown ("tell me more about the plumber", "what does the second one do?"). NOT THIS TOOL: Never state a contact detail yourself (see listings_display). The card is sent for you, so your whole answer is [sent]. ⚠ A message with a list of contact buttons, sent for you.
